info.title: Growwer API
info.description:
The Growwer customer API. Authenticate every call with an API key created on
your profile page, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. A read key can call
every GET operation; writes need a read and write key and an
`Idempotency-Key` header.

Idempotency: use a new `Idempotency-Key` (1 to 255 printable ASCII
characters without spaces) for each operation and reuse it only to retry that same
operation. Keys belong to your account, not to one API key.
- A successful write is stored for 30 days: a retry with the same key and
  the same request replays its response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`
  and does nothing again.
- A refused write (4xx) has no effect and releases its key: once you fix the
  cause, retry with the same key and the write runs.
- A failed write (5xx) may have taken effect, so it is never run again under
  its key: a retry gets 409 `idempotency_outcome_unknown`. Check whether it
  took effect before retrying with a new key.
- A retry while the first request is still running gets 409
  `idempotency_request_in_progress`. A request still running after 5 minutes
  is treated as failed: a retry gets 409 `idempotency_outcome_unknown`.
- The same key with a different request (method, path, query or body) gets
  409 `idempotency_key_reused`. A write without the header gets 400
  `idempotency_key_required`.

Every response carries `X-Request-Id`. Errors share one shape,
`{code, message, requestId, details?}`. Money is integer cents plus a
currency code and dates are ISO-8601.

get.description: Profile basics, the buyer and seller balances, whether your seller account is restricted, whether the catalogue is open to you, and whether you have a managed service.

200.description: Your account.

language.description: The language Growwer writes to you in.

restricted.description: Whether your seller account is restricted: it accepts no orders and its balance is held. Contact support for the reason.

onHoliday.description: Whether you are on holiday: your medias take no orders. Set it with PUT /seller/holiday.

holidayEndDate.description: The day your holiday ends, at 00:00 of that day in Growwer's server time, or null when you are not on holiday or end it yourself.

eligible.description: Whether the catalogue operations (tag Catalogue: searching a project's medias, flash offers and media details) are open to you. They are open to accounts with recent completed orders, as buyer or as seller; until then they answer 403 `catalogue_requires_recent_order`. A media you have ordered is always readable with GET /medias/{id}.

active.description: Whether you have a managed service: Growwer's team runs link building campaigns for you (tag Managed services). With one, request a new campaign with POST /managed-service/campaign-requests; without one, ask about the service with POST /managed-service/info-requests.

get.description: The countries, languages, topics, product types, link types and order states that other operations take and return. Names are in English.

200.description: Every code, with its English name where it has one.

languages.description: ISO 639 codes, as the web's language selectors offer them.

productTypes.description: What an order buys: a sponsored post, or a link added to an existing page.

get.summary: Count the medias of a saved filter
get.description: How many medias of the project's catalogue one of your saved filters matches: the `total` of GET /projects/{id}/medias with its `savedFilterId`. The number is cached for up to 24 hours, and it can differ from the count the web shows, which is not limited to the project's catalogue. A filter saved on the web that uses a filter the API does not support is refused with 422 `saved_filter_unsupported`.

200.description: The number of matching medias.

422.description: The saved filter uses a web filter the API does not support (code `saved_filter_unsupported`); `details.field` names it.

get.summary: List the saved filters of a project
get.description: Your saved filters of one of your projects, newest first, including those saved on the web. A project has at most 100. Apply one with `savedFilterId` on GET /projects/{id}/medias.

200.description: The saved filters and how many there are.

post.description: Saves a catalogue search of one of your projects, which then also appears on the web. `filters` takes the filter parameters of GET /projects/{id}/medias, and `source`, with the same values; lists may be JSON arrays and flags JSON booleans. With `notificationFrequency`, Growwer emails you new medias that match. A project has at most 100 saved filters and an account 500.

filters.description: At least one filter parameter of GET /projects/{id}/medias, or `source`, by name.

notificationFrequency.description: Email new matching medias this often. Omit it for no emails.

409.description: The project already has 100 saved filters, or the account 500 (code `saved_filter_limit_reached`), or the `Idempotency-Key` conflicts (codes `idempotency_key_reused`, `idempotency_request_in_progress`, `idempotency_outcome_unknown`).

delete.description: Deletes one of your saved filters of one of your projects, including one saved on the web. Its notifications stop.

put.summary: Discard a media for a project
put.description: Discards a media for one of your projects, as the web does. Discarding it again changes nothing. The media must be one the catalogue shows for the project: another media, including one of your own as a seller, is answered as not found.

204.description: The media is discarded for the project.

delete.summary: Restore a discarded media for a project
delete.description: Restores a media you discarded for one of your projects. Restoring one that is not discarded changes nothing. It works for any media, even one the catalogue no longer shows.

204.description: The media is not discarded for the project.

put.summary: Add a media to the favourites of a project
put.description: Marks a media as a favourite of one of your projects, as the heart on the web does. Adding a favourite again changes nothing. The media must be one the catalogue shows for the project: another media, including one of your own as a seller, is answered as not found.

204.description: The media is a favourite of the project.

delete.summary: Remove a media from the favourites of a project
delete.description: Removes a media from the favourites of one of your projects. Removing one that is not a favourite changes nothing. It works for any media, even one the catalogue no longer shows.

204.description: The media is not a favourite of the project.

get.description: One media of the catalogue: an active, public media. A media you have ordered is always readable, even if it has since left the catalogue, and is open to every account. Otherwise the catalogue is open to accounts with recent completed orders (see `catalogue.eligible` on GET /me), and the media counts towards the distinct medias the account may see per day (UTC). For the media's state in one of your projects, search the project with GET /projects/{id}/medias.

200.description: The media.

get.description: The medias on a flash offer, a time-limited discount, in the catalogue of one of your projects. It is GET /projects/{id}/medias with `flashOffer=true`, and takes the same parameters except `flashOffer` and `savedFilterId`. The catalogue access and the daily distinct-media limit of that operation apply.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: The project to search flash offers for.

200.description: A page of flash offers and how many there are in all.

post.summary: Request specific medias for a project
post.description: Asks Growwer to find the medias of these domains for one of your projects, as the "request specific domains" form on the web does. Each entry may be a domain or a URL; it is read as its full domain, lowercased. Repeated domains are requested once, and a domain already requested changes nothing. Up to 200 distinct domains per call. They then appear in the project's catalogue with `project.requested` true (`requested=true` on GET /projects/{id}/medias) once Growwer lists them.

domains.description: Domains or URLs, 1 to 200 distinct domains.

201.description: The domains were requested: each distinct domain, as Growwer read it.

get.summary: Search the catalogue for a project
get.description: The medias the catalogue offers for one of your projects, as the web lists them, with each media's state in the project. Filter with the parameters below, which all combine, or apply one of your saved filters with `savedFilterId` alone. The catalogue is open to accounts with recent completed orders (see `catalogue.eligible` on GET /me), and each account can see a limited number of distinct medias per day (UTC) across the catalogue operations; medias seen again the same day are free.

parameters.name: savedFilterId
parameters.description: Apply one of your saved filters of this project, including one saved on the web, instead of the other parameters. Do not combine it with any filter, `source` or `sort`. A filter saved on the web that uses a filter the API does not support is refused with 422 `saved_filter_unsupported`.

200.description: A page of matching medias and how many match in all.

422.description: A parameter is not valid (code `validation_failed`; `details.fields` names it), or the saved filter uses a web filter the API does not support (code `saved_filter_unsupported`; `details.field` names it).

post.description: Uploads a document (odt, doc, docx or txt, up to 8 MB) for a later write to reference by its `id`. A file belongs to you, can be used by one write, and expires 24 hours after it was uploaded; an expired or used file is answered like an unknown one.

name.description: The name the file was uploaded with.

422.description: No file was sent as the `file` field, or it is too large, not an odt, doc, docx or txt document, or its name is longer than 255 characters (code `validation_failed`).

get.description: The PDF of one of your invoices.

200.description: The invoice.

get.description: The invoices of your top-ups, newest first.

200.description: A page of your invoices and how many you have in all.

post.description:
Totals the campaign's accepted proposals that still await their order and the `proposed` ones you name in `accept`, and compares the total with your wallet's available balance. Each proposal counts at its `currentPrice`, or at its `proposedPrice` when the media no longer offers the service. Nothing is accepted, charged or reserved, so a read-only key may call it and it takes no Idempotency-Key.

The estimate is advisory: accepting a proposal charges nothing. The team charges your wallet when it places the order for an accepted proposal, and the same balance pays for the orders you place yourself.

200.description: The totals and how your wallet covers them.

400.description: The body is not a JSON object (code `invalid_json`).

404.description: The campaign is not yours, or a proposal named in `accept` is not one of the campaign's (code `not_found`, with `details.proposalId`).

409.description: A proposal named in `accept` is not awaiting your review (code `invalid_state`, with `details.proposalIds`).

200.description: The campaign.

get.summary: Download the summary of a campaign's proposals
get.description: The PDF the campaign page offers: the proposals awaiting your review, accepted or being published, newest first, in your language. With `extended=true` it also shows each proposal's price, the price it was proposed at (`proposedPrice`).

200.description: The summary.

get.description: The campaigns your managed service runs for you, newest first. Without a managed service the list is empty: GET /me says whether you have one.

200.description: A page of your campaigns and how many you have in all.

get.summary: List the proposals of a campaign
get.description: The medias the team proposes for the campaign, newest first. Those `proposed` await your review (POST /managed-service/campaigns/{id}/proposals/review).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Only proposals in these states, comma-separated: `proposed`, `accepted`, `cancelled`, `purchase_started`, `purchase_finished`.

200.description: A page of the campaign's proposals and how many match in all.

post.description:
Asks your account manager for a new campaign, as the managed service page does: the team emails you to agree on it. For accounts with a managed service (GET /me `managedService.active`); without one, POST /managed-service/info-requests asks about the service.

You may send 5 such requests per UTC day through the API. Past them it answers 429 `managed_service_request_limit_reached`, with `Retry-After` the time to the next UTC midnight. A request that is refused (4xx) does not count; one that fails on the server (5xx) does, as it may have been sent.

409.description: You have no managed service yet (code `managed_service_required`), or the `Idempotency-Key` conflicts (codes `idempotency_key_reused`, `idempotency_request_in_progress`, `idempotency_outcome_unknown`).

post.description:
Asks the team about the managed service for your website, as the managed service landing page does: the team contacts you. For accounts without a managed service (GET /me `managedService.active`); with one, POST /managed-service/campaign-requests requests a new campaign.

You may send 5 such requests per UTC day through the API. Past them it answers 429 `managed_service_request_limit_reached`, with `Retry-After` the time to the next UTC midnight. A request that is refused (4xx) does not count; one that fails on the server (5xx) does, as it may have been sent.

409.description: You already have a managed service (code `managed_service_exists`), or the `Idempotency-Key` conflicts (codes `idempotency_key_reused`, `idempotency_request_in_progress`, `idempotency_outcome_unknown`).

post.description:
Decides on every proposal of the campaign that awaits your review (`state` `proposed`), as the campaign page does: name each one once, with `accept` or `reject`, and a comment for the team to reject one. Their order in the body does not matter. Accepting charges nothing: the team places the orders for the accepted proposals and your wallet pays for them then. POST /managed-service/campaigns/{id}/proposals/estimate says what they would cost.

When every proposal is accepted the campaign moves to `proposal_accepted`; when one is rejected the team is told and prepares others. A proposal someone else moved on the campaign page while the request ran is answered in the state it reached.

200.description: The campaign and the proposals you reviewed, as they now are.

404.description: The campaign is not yours, or a proposal named is not one of the campaign's (code `not_found`, with `details.proposalId`).

409.description: No proposal of the campaign awaits your review (code `no_pending_proposals`), or a proposal named does not (code `invalid_state`, with `details.proposalIds`), or the `Idempotency-Key` conflicts (codes `idempotency_key_reused`, `idempotency_request_in_progress`, `idempotency_outcome_unknown`).

422.description: The body is invalid (code `validation_failed`), or it leaves out proposals awaiting your review (code `review_incomplete`, with `details.missingProposalIds`).

post.description: Approves the delivery of an order whose `pendingAction` is yours to review the delivery, as the web does. The order finishes and the seller is paid. It takes no body.

200.description: The order, approved.

409.description: The order is not pending your review of its delivery (code `invalid_state`), or the `Idempotency-Key` conflicts (codes `idempotency_key_reused`, `idempotency_request_in_progress`, `idempotency_outcome_unknown`).

post.description: Approves the draft of a post order whose `pendingAction` is yours to review the draft (GET /orders/{id}/draft downloads it), as the web does. The seller then publishes it. It takes no body.

200.description: The order, with its draft approved.

409.description: The order is not a post order with a draft pending your review (code `invalid_state`), or the `Idempotency-Key` conflicts (codes `idempotency_key_reused`, `idempotency_request_in_progress`, `idempotency_outcome_unknown`).

post.description: Cancels an order the seller has not accepted yet (`state` `pending_acceptance`), as the web does. Its price returns to your wallet's available balance, and the seller is told your reason.

200.description: The order, cancelled.

409.description: The seller has already accepted or refused the order, or it has finished (code `invalid_state`), or the `Idempotency-Key` conflicts (codes `idempotency_key_reused`, `idempotency_request_in_progress`, `idempotency_outcome_unknown`).

get.description: The orders you bought, newest first by default. To follow your orders, poll with `sort=updatedAt` and `updatedSince` set to the `updatedAt` of the last order you saw: an order moves to the end of that list each time it changes state.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Only the orders of this project of yours.

parameters.name: mediaId
parameters.description: Only the orders on this media.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Only the orders in one of these states, comma-separated. An unknown state is refused with 422 and the list of valid ones.

parameters.name: updatedSince
parameters.description: Only the orders whose `updatedAt` is at or after this instant, an ISO-8601 date-time with its offset (send `+` as `%2B`).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `-createdAt`, newest first, or `updatedAt`, least recently changed first. Orders of the same instant come in id order.

200.description: A page of your orders and how many match in all.

post.description:
Places an order on a media for one of your projects and pays its price from your wallet's available balance, as ordering on the web does. Estimate the order first (POST /orders/estimate) and send the price it answers as `expectedPrice`: the order is placed only at that price.

Placing the same order (same project, media, type and price) again within 5 seconds of one still in progress is refused with `duplicate_order`. Its `details.orderId` is the earlier order, or null when that order has finished or was deleted since.

A proposed draft (`proposedDraftFileId`, from POST /files) is used up when the order is placed. If the order is then refused because another request changed your balance, the media or its price, or placed the same order, the file is used up all the same and the refusal's message says so: upload it again before retrying.

201.description: The order, placed and paid. `Location` is its URL.

Location.description: The URL of the new order.

404.description: The project is not yours, or the media does not exist or is not one you can order for this project (code `not_found`).

409.description:
The order cannot be placed, and nothing was charged:
- `price_changed`: the price is not `expectedPrice`; `details.currentPrice` is the price.
- `insufficient_balance`: your available balance does not cover the price; `details` has `required`, `available` and `missing` (Money).
- `duplicate_order`: the same order was placed seconds ago; `details.orderId` is that order, or null.
- `seller_on_holiday`: the media is not taking orders right now.
- `media_topic_not_allowed`: the media does not accept the project's topic.
- `offer_unavailable`: the media does not offer this type of order.
- `idempotency_key_reused`, `idempotency_request_in_progress`, `idempotency_outcome_unknown`: the `Idempotency-Key` conflicts.

422.description: The body is not valid (code `validation_failed`, with the messages of each field in `details.fields`), or `proposedDraftFileId` names no file you can use: it does not exist, has expired or was already used (code `file_unusable`).

get.summary: Download the draft you attached to an order
get.description: The file you attached to the briefing of a post order. 404 when the order has none (`briefing.hasProposedDraft` is false) or the file cannot be read.

200.description: The file, with its own content type and name.

get.summary: Download the draft of an order
get.description: The file of the current draft of a post order. 404 when the order has no draft file (`draft.hasFile` is false) or the file cannot be read.

200.description: The file, with its own content type and name.

post.description:
Checks and prices the order POST /orders would place with the same body, without `expectedPrice`, and compares the price with your wallet's available balance. Nothing is placed, charged or used up, so a read-only key may call it and it takes no Idempotency-Key. Send the `price` it answers as `expectedPrice` when you place the order.

The estimate is refused for the same reasons as the order itself, except a balance that does not cover the price: that is answered here with `sufficientBalance: false` and the `missing` amount.

200.description: The price of the order and how your wallet covers it.

400.description: The body is not a JSON object (code `invalid_json`).

404.description: The project is not yours, or the media does not exist or is not one you can order for this project (code `not_found`).

409.description:
The order could not be placed:
- `seller_on_holiday`: the media is not taking orders right now.
- `media_topic_not_allowed`: the media does not accept the project's topic.
- `offer_unavailable`: the media does not offer this type of order.

422.description: The body is not valid (code `validation_failed`, with the messages of each field in `details.fields`), or `proposedDraftFileId` names no file you can use: it does not exist, has expired or was already used (code `file_unusable`).

get.description: One order you bought, with its briefing, its draft and its state history.

200.description: The order.

post.description: Asks the seller to change the draft of a post order whose `pendingAction` is yours to review the draft, as the web does. The seller is told your reason.

200.description: The order, with its draft back with the seller.

409.description: The order is not a post order with a draft pending your review (code `invalid_state`), or the `Idempotency-Key` conflicts (codes `idempotency_key_reused`, `idempotency_request_in_progress`, `idempotency_outcome_unknown`).

post.description: Asks the seller to change the delivery of an order whose `pendingAction` is yours to review the delivery, as the web does. The seller is told your reason.

200.description: The order, back with the seller.

409.description: The order is not pending your review of its delivery (code `invalid_state`), or the `Idempotency-Key` conflicts (codes `idempotency_key_reused`, `idempotency_request_in_progress`, `idempotency_outcome_unknown`).

get.description: Your projects, newest first.

200.description: A page of your projects and how many you have in all.

post.description:
Creates a project for a website, as the web's project creation does. Growwer then analyses it in the background to recommend media: the project is answered with `state: analyzing` and turns `finished` when the analysis ends. Analysis can take hours, and it never finishes when no medium matches the project, so poll GET /projects/{id} with backoff and use `createdAt` to decide when to stop.

Every value is validated as on the web: `topics`, `language` and `country` take the identifiers GET /vocabulary publishes.

Creating a project also categorises its website through an external service, as the web does. When that service fails the answer is 500, although the project may already be saved, and a retry under the same Idempotency-Key answers 409 `idempotency_outcome_unknown`. After either, list your projects (GET /projects) before retrying with a new key, or you may create a duplicate.

topics.description: Exactly one topic id from GET /vocabulary.

country.description: A country code from GET /vocabulary; omit it or send null for worldwide.

promotedProducts.description: 5 to 10 products or services the campaign promotes.

userKeywords.description: At most 100 keywords, none with a line break.

202.description: The project, created and being analysed. `Location` is its URL.

Location.description: The URL of the new project.

403.description: The key is read-only (code `insufficient_capability`), or you have reached the number of projects an account may have without a wallet deposit in the last year (code `project_limit_reached`).

get.description: One of your projects. Poll it to follow `state` after creating the project.

200.description: The project.

delete.description: Deletes one of your projects. A project with an order in progress cannot be deleted until its orders finish.

409.description: The project has an order in progress (code `invalid_state`), or the `Idempotency-Key` conflicts (codes `idempotency_key_reused`, `idempotency_request_in_progress`, `idempotency_outcome_unknown`).

patch.description: Changes only the fields you send. `rootUrl` cannot be changed; any field not listed here is refused. Changing `language`, `country`, `promotedProducts` or `topics` makes Growwer categorise the project and work out its target keywords again, in the background.

name.description: Null or an empty string removes the name.

topics.description: Exactly one topic id from GET /vocabulary.

country.description: A country code from GET /vocabulary, or null for worldwide.

promotedProducts.description: 5 to 10 products or services the campaign promotes.

userKeywords.description: At most 100 keywords, none with a line break.

200.description: The project as edited.

put.description:
Starts, changes or ends your holiday, as the holiday settings of your profile page do. While you are on holiday your medias take no orders. `endDate` is the day your holiday ends, at 00:00 of that day in Growwer's server time, and must be later than now; leave it out, or send null, for a holiday you end yourself. Ending the holiday takes no `endDate`.

A holiday that already is as you ask is answered 200 without a change. A restricted seller account stays on holiday until the restriction is lifted, so any change is refused. Your holiday is also in GET /me.

200.description: Your holiday, as it now is.

endDate.description: The day the holiday ends, at 00:00 of that day in Growwer's server time, or null for none.

409.description: Your seller account is restricted, so its holiday cannot change (code `seller_restricted`), or the `Idempotency-Key` conflicts (codes `idempotency_key_reused`, `idempotency_request_in_progress`, `idempotency_outcome_unknown`).

422.description: The body is not valid (code `validation_failed`): an `endDate` that is not a later day, or one sent with `onHoliday` false.

post.summary: Set the competitive fees Growwer suggests
post.description:
Sets your post fees for the media to the competitive fees Growwer suggests, the `competitiveFees` of GET /seller/medias/{id}, as the button on the media edit page does. Each link type you offer gets the suggested fee on each side it already has a fee for; no link type gains a side it did not offer.

Two differences from the page: a side Growwer has no suggestion for keeps your fee (the page clears it), and the fixed fee the page falls back to when it cannot find a competitive one is never applied (the page applies it). When neither side has a suggestion, nothing changes and the answer is 409 `no_competitive_fees`. When your fees already are the suggested ones, or the suggestion is only for a side none of your link types offers, nothing changes and the answer is 200.

The fees set are your base fees: a running flash offer keeps discounting them. As with a fee edit, a change of the price may cancel the managed-service proposals accepted for the media whose price it changes. Send no body, or an empty object.

200.description: The media, with the suggested fees set.

409.description: Growwer has no competitive fees to suggest for the media now (code `no_competitive_fees`), or the `Idempotency-Key` conflicts (codes `idempotency_key_reused`, `idempotency_request_in_progress`, `idempotency_outcome_unknown`).

422.description: The body is not empty, or the fees set break a rule of the media edit page (code `validation_failed`). Nothing changed.

get.summary: Get a media you sell on
get.description: One of your medias, with your fees, its extras, the competitive fees Growwer suggests and how it performs. Another seller's media is not found.

200.description: The media.

patch.summary: Edit the fees of a media you sell on
patch.description:
Sets the fees of one of your medias, as the media edit page saves them. Send only the sections you change: a section you send replaces that section wholly, a section you leave out stays as it is.

- `postOffer.pricingOptions` lists every link type you offer for sponsored posts, at least one. A link type you leave out is no longer offered. Each option needs at least one fee, and every option must offer the same sides (written by you, written by the buyer or Growwer), as the page requires. Each fee is at least 1 EUR.
- `linkAdditionOffer.pricingOptions` lists the link types you offer for adding a link to an existing article; `null` or an empty list stops offering link additions.
- `extraServices` is the full list of extra services you offer; an empty list removes them all.

The fees are your base fees, the ones GET /seller/medias/{id} returns: while a flash offer runs, its discount keeps applying on top of them, and `currentCost` shows the result. `currentCost` may be sent back as read and is ignored. Characteristics, topics and comments are not edited here.

As on the page, a change of the post offer's price may cancel the managed-service proposals accepted for the media whose price it changes, and raising the price above the best competitor's tells Growwer's support team. A restricted seller account may edit its fees.

feeWhenSellerWritesPost.description: What you are paid for a post you write; null or left out when you do not offer it.

feeWhenSellerDoesNotWritePost.description: What you are paid for a post the buyer or Growwer writes; null or left out when you do not offer it.

fee.description: Your base fee for adding a link of this type.

cost.description: What you are paid for the extra service.

200.description: The media, with the fees saved.

409.description: The `Idempotency-Key` conflicts (codes `idempotency_key_reused`, `idempotency_request_in_progress`, `idempotency_outcome_unknown`).

422.description: The body is not valid (code `validation_failed`): `details.fields` names each field by its path in the body, such as `postOffer.pricingOptions.0.feeWhenSellerWritesPost`, with the rule the media edit page applies. Nothing changed.

get.summary: List the medias you sell on
get.description: Your medias in every state, with your fees and how they perform, newest first by default.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Only the medias in one of these states, comma-separated: `analyzing`, `pending_review`, `active`, `deactivated`. An unknown state is refused with 422.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: By creation date, number of published orders or publication rate; a leading `-` sorts descending. Medias with no publication rate come first ascending, last descending. Ties come in id order.

200.description: A page of your medias and how many match in all.

get.summary: Download the document of a seller wallet movement
get.description: The document Growwer attached to a movement of your seller wallet. 404 when the movement has none (`hasDocument` is false) or the file cannot be read.

200.description: The document, with its own content type and name.

post.description: Accepts an order placed on one of your medias (`state` `pending_acceptance`), as the web does. A post order whose draft is still to be written (by you or by Growwer) moves to `pending_draft`; any other order moves to `pending_order_delivery`. The buyer is told. Takes no body.

200.description: The order, accepted.

409.description: The order is not waiting for your acceptance (code `invalid_state`), your seller account is restricted and accepts no orders (code `seller_restricted`; support can tell you why), or the `Idempotency-Key` conflicts (codes `idempotency_key_reused`, `idempotency_request_in_progress`, `idempotency_outcome_unknown`).

post.description: Delivers an order placed on one of your medias (`state` `pending_order_delivery`), as the web does. A post order takes the URL of the published post and the confirmation of its publication date; a link addition order takes no body, and any field is refused. The order moves to `pending_order_delivery_review` and the buyer is asked to review it, or, for a post order whose scheduled publication date is still to come, to `scheduled` without telling the buyer yet. The URL is checked to be a URL only, as the web does.

200.description: The order, delivered or scheduled.

409.description: The order is not waiting for its delivery (code `invalid_state`), or the `Idempotency-Key` conflicts (codes `idempotency_key_reused`, `idempotency_request_in_progress`, `idempotency_outcome_unknown`).

post.description: Delivers the draft of a post order placed on one of your medias whose draft you write (`state` `pending_draft`), as the web does, from a file you uploaded with POST /files. The order moves to `pending_draft_review` when the buyer reviews drafts, otherwise to `pending_order_delivery`. The file is used up once the draft is delivered; a refused request leaves it usable.

200.description: The order, with its draft delivered.

409.description: The order is not waiting for a draft you write (code `invalid_state`), or the `Idempotency-Key` conflicts (codes `idempotency_key_reused`, `idempotency_request_in_progress`, `idempotency_outcome_unknown`).

422.description: The body is not valid, or the file is not an odt, doc, docx or txt file of up to 8 MB (code `validation_failed`, with the messages of each field in `details.fields`), or `fileId` names no file you can use: it does not exist, has expired or was already used (code `file_unusable`).

post.description: Delivers the draft update the buyer asked for on a post order placed on one of your medias whose draft you write (`state` `pending_draft_update`), as the web does, from a file you uploaded with POST /files. The order moves back to `pending_draft_review`. The file is used up once the draft is delivered; a refused request leaves it usable.

200.description: The order, with its updated draft delivered.

409.description: The buyer has not asked for an update of a draft you write (code `invalid_state`), or the `Idempotency-Key` conflicts (codes `idempotency_key_reused`, `idempotency_request_in_progress`, `idempotency_outcome_unknown`).

422.description: The body is not valid, or the file is not an odt, doc, docx or txt file of up to 8 MB (code `validation_failed`, with the messages of each field in `details.fields`), or `fileId` names no file you can use: it does not exist, has expired or was already used (code `file_unusable`).

post.description: Delivers the update the buyer asked for on an order placed on one of your medias (`state` `pending_order_delivery_update`), as the web does. A post order takes the URL of the published post, which may be the same as before, and the confirmation of its publication date; both must be sent. A link addition order takes no body, and any field is refused. The order moves back to `pending_order_delivery_review` and the buyer is asked to review it.

200.description: The order, with the update delivered.

409.description: The buyer has not asked for an update (code `invalid_state`), or the `Idempotency-Key` conflicts (codes `idempotency_key_reused`, `idempotency_request_in_progress`, `idempotency_outcome_unknown`).

get.description: The orders placed on your medias, newest first by default. To follow them, poll with `sort=updatedAt` and `updatedSince` set to the `updatedAt` of the last order you saw: an order moves to the end of that list each time it changes state. The orders you bought are under GET /orders.

parameters.name: mediaId
parameters.description: Only the orders on this media of yours.

parameters.name: state

parameters.name: updatedSince
parameters.description: Only the orders whose `updatedAt` is at or after this instant, an ISO-8601 date-time with its offset (send `+` as `%2B`).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `-createdAt`, newest first, or `updatedAt`, least recently changed first. Orders of the same instant come in id order.

200.description: A page of the orders you sell and how many match in all.

post.description: Refuses the draft update the buyer asked for on a post order placed on one of your medias whose draft you write (`state` `pending_draft_update`), as the web does. The order moves back to `pending_draft_review` and the buyer is told your reason. A draft Growwer or the buyer writes cannot be refused here.

200.description: The order, with its draft back in review.

409.description: The buyer has not asked for an update of a draft you write, including when Growwer or the buyer writes the draft (code `invalid_state`), or the `Idempotency-Key` conflicts (codes `idempotency_key_reused`, `idempotency_request_in_progress`, `idempotency_outcome_unknown`).

post.description: Refuses the update the buyer asked for on an order placed on one of your medias (`state` `pending_order_delivery_update`), as the web does. The order moves back to `pending_order_delivery_review` and the buyer is told your reason.

200.description: The order, back in review.

409.description: The buyer has not asked for an update (code `invalid_state`), or the `Idempotency-Key` conflicts (codes `idempotency_key_reused`, `idempotency_request_in_progress`, `idempotency_outcome_unknown`).

post.description: Rejects an order placed on one of your medias that you have not accepted yet (`state` `pending_acceptance`), as the web does. The order moves to `rejected_by_seller`, its price returns to the buyer, and the buyer is told your reason.

200.description: The order, rejected.

409.description: The order is not waiting for your acceptance (code `invalid_state`), or the `Idempotency-Key` conflicts (codes `idempotency_key_reused`, `idempotency_request_in_progress`, `idempotency_outcome_unknown`).

TooManyRequests.description: Over the rate limit (code `rate_limit_exceeded`), or too many failed authentications from this address (code `too_many_failed_authentications`). On the catalogue operations, also when the response would take the account beyond the distinct medias it may see per UTC day (code `catalogue_daily_cap_reached`): `details.remaining` says how many new medias still fit today, `Retry-After` is the time to the next UTC midnight, and medias already seen today stay readable. On the managed service requests, also when you sent as many requests of that kind as you may per UTC day (code `managed_service_request_limit_reached`): `Retry-After` is the time to the next UTC midnight.

CataloguePromotedSocialNetwork.description: A comma-separated list of social networks the media promotes posts on: `twitter`, `instagram`, `facebook`, `pinterest`, `tumblr`, `newsletter`.

CatalogueWithoutAdvertisingLabel.name: withoutAdvertisingLabel
CatalogueWithoutAdvertisingLabel.description: Medias that never label posts as advertising. Only `true` applies it; omit it otherwise.

CatalogueHomepageListing.name: homepageListing
CatalogueHomepageListing.description: Medias that offer listing the post on their homepage. Only `true` applies it; omit it otherwise.

CatalogueHasLinkAddition.name: hasLinkAddition
CatalogueHasLinkAddition.description: Medias that offer adding a link to an existing article. Only `true` applies it; omit it otherwise.

CatalogueMinLinkAdditionPrice.name: minLinkAdditionPrice
CatalogueMinLinkAdditionPrice.description: Minimum link addition price, in cents.

CatalogueMaxLinkAdditionPrice.name: maxLinkAdditionPrice
CatalogueMaxLinkAdditionPrice.description: Maximum link addition price, in cents.

CatalogueLinkAdditionLinkType.name: linkAdditionLinkType
CatalogueLinkAdditionLinkType.description: A comma-separated list of link types the link addition offer gives: `dofollow`, `nofollow`, `citation`.

CatalogueRecommended.name: recommended
CatalogueRecommended.description: `true`: only the medias Growwer recommends for the project; `false`: only the others.

CatalogueFavourite.name: favourite
CatalogueFavourite.description: `true`: only your favourites for the project; `false`: leave them out.

CatalogueRequested.name: requested
CatalogueRequested.description: `true`: only the medias you requested for the project; `false`: leave them out.

CatalogueFlashOffer.name: flashOffer
CatalogueFlashOffer.description: `true`: only medias with a flash offer running; `false`: leave them out.

CatalogueBought.name: bought
CatalogueBought.description: `true`: only medias you bought for the project; `false`: leave them out.

CatalogueDiscarded.name: discarded
CatalogueDiscarded.description: `true`: only the medias you discarded for the project; `false`: leave them out.

CatalogueNew.name: new
CatalogueNew.description: Medias Growwer matched with the project recently. Only `true` applies it; omit it otherwise.

CatalogueRanksGoalKeyword.name: ranksGoalKeyword
CatalogueRanksGoalKeyword.description: A comma-separated list of keyword origins: medias that rank for a keyword of the project from any of them. `user`: your keywords; `publicGenerated`: keywords Growwer found for the project.

CatalogueRanksAiKeyword.name: ranksAiKeyword
CatalogueRanksAiKeyword.description: A comma-separated list of AI answer engines: medias cited for a keyword of the project by any of them. `googleAiOverview`, `chatgpt`, `googleAiMode`.

RateLimitLimit.description: Requests allowed in the current window.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

RateLimitReset.description: Seconds until the current window resets.

apiKey.description: An API key from your profile page.
